verdict.rationale: Docs show Stagehand attaches to any existing Chromium browser via CDP (localBrowser.connect) and lets developers use familiar Playwright page methods/selectors directly alongside AI actions, which supports bringing over existing Playwright/CDP automation code. However, there's no explicit mention of Puppeteer compatibility, and one community comment notes Stagehand is designed to run directly rather than as a drop-in wrapper for pre-existing Playwright/Puppeteer test suites. Missing for 10: explicit Puppeteer support/migration docs, hands-on confirmation of reusing full existing Playwright/Puppeteer codebases without rewrites.
